statusDefinitions.as-cited: Citation copied as printed in the L1 decision; the cited decision itself was not read.
statusDefinitions.read: The source document was opened and quoted.

precedents.citation: LCX AG v 1.274M U.S. Dollar Coin, 2022 NY Slip Op 32834[U]
precedents.point: Service on anonymous defendants by a token airdrop (not an NFT) linking to a website with the papers. A trial-court order (as cited; the decision itself was not read).
precedents.note: Citation form as printed on p.4 of the L1 decision. The OAG memorandum cites the same matter as LCX AG v. John Doe Nos. 1-25, No. 154644/2022.

precedents.citation: Meghji v Wallet Owner (In re Celsius Network LLC), 666 BR 28 [Bankr SD NY 2024]
precedents.point: Service by airdropped NFT into crypto wallets of unidentifiable owners. A bankruptcy-court order (as cited; the decision itself was not read).

precedents.citation: People v Unknown Parties in Ownership and/or Control of Digital Wallet Addresses, Sup Ct, Queens County, Index No. 700647/2025, reported as 2025 NY Slip Op 25143 (official text not retrieved)
precedents.point: Service by airdropping NFTs hyperlinked to a website with the papers to three wallet addresses (CPLR 308(5)); service complete on filing of the affidavit. A trial-court order on an unopposed motion.
precedents.note: Signed 2025-06-09, entered 2025-06-11 (NYSCEF 21). A web search lists it as 2025 NY Slip Op 25143 (one search summary also gave 87 Misc 3d 950). The official text was not retrieved: on 2026-10-25 nycourts.gov returned 403, law.justia.com returned 403, Casetext returned 410, CourtListener search returned no results and Google Scholar returned a captcha. The order itself was read from the ag.ny.gov PDF.

scope: Trial-level orders granting motions for alternative service that no defendant opposed (the 2025 order was on an unopposed motion). None is an appellate ruling.
